summary: Genmab A/S furnished a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, attaching a company announcement reporting third-quarter 2026 worldwide net trade sales of DARZALEX (daratumumab), including subcutaneous DARZALEX FASPRO, of USD 4,239 million as reported by Johnson & Johnson; U.S. sales were USD 2,528 million and rest-of-world USD 1,711 million. Genmab receives royalties on those worldwide net sales under its exclusive worldwide license to J&J (Janssen Biotech) to develop, manufacture, and commercialize daratumumab. No transaction, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or structural change is disclosed; the filing is a routine royalty-bearing sales update. Watch quarterly DARZALEX sales and royalty trends as the key earnings driver.
